# Configuring the registry for Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation {#configuring-registry-storage-rhodf}

To configure the {{ product_registry }} on bare metal and vSphere to use {{ rh_storage_first }} storage, you must install {{ rh_storage }} and then configure image registry using Ceph or Noobaa.

## Additional resources {#configuring-registry-storage-ocs}
